cautions.quote: Once the isolation level goes up, it stays that way for the whole transaction.
For ReadCommitted, RepeatableRead, and UpdLock, every Get() is forced to round-trip to SQL Server.
The NST record cache only serves Get() calls from cache when ReadIsolation is set to Default or ReadUncommitted.
Be carefult on this behavior and check your AL code… transaction isolation level setting is not just a "write this and go" sentence.
